name: Oil Cooler Banjo Bolt (M22x1.5 to 10AN) w/ Safety Wire Holes
title: Oil Cooler Banjo Bolt (M22x1.5 to 10AN) w/ Safety Wire Holes
description:
The Oil Cooler Banjo Bolt (M22x1.5 to 10AN) w/ Safety Wire Holes is a premium high-performance component engineered for rigorous fluid and boost applications. A Metric M22x1.5 to 10AN Banjo Bolt perfect for Oil Coolers or other tight-fitting areas. their banjo bolts are pre-drilled for safety wire to prevent accidental rotation. Includes the banjo fitting, banjo bolt, and washer pair.

This Banjo Bolt is available in the following color: Black

Technical Specifications:
• Construction: Precision CNC-machined in the USA. (6061-T6 Billet Aluminum for fittings)
